_doc: Capability eval corpus for scripts/eval_capabilities.py and
domovoi/tests/test_capability_corpus.py: how Domovoi answers questions about
its own abilities, per house state. The owner-approved question list (250
cases, kept outside the repo) is the source; ids match its numbers, with a
letter suffix where one row asks the same question of several houses.
id          - the list's number ('16.1', '5.10a')
utterance   - what the person said or typed
where       - voice (a satellite room) | chat (home-server chat) | phone
(the phone's own assistant, not connected: never run here)
house       - a fixture in scripts/capability_houses/ (extends base)
expect      - CAN | CANT | DEPENDS | ADMIN | DO_IT | EXACT
kind        - question | command: the can't-do hedge fails a question
and is acceptable on a command the router missed
handler     - optional: the handler that must answer (a DO_IT's doer)
must_include / must_not_include - regexes, case-insensitive
allow_plugin_names - the person asked which plugins are installed:
plugin names are allowed (owner, 2026-11-25)
allow_names - lift single name checks ('listenbrainz', 'plugin', 'provider')
judge, rubric - needs a judge model (--judge-model) to score fully
needs_change - a known gap still open (N1..N16; N7/N10 resolved, the rest fixed in 1.4.1):
failing is expected
status      - verified (checked in code) | unverified (as the list marks it)
skip_reason - never run (phone app, 1.5.0, multi-turn, non-turn inputs)
stub        - answered without a model or database: the CI test runs it
device      - typed chat: the phone or browser (the house's devices); thread: its
thread; before: turns said first ({say, device?, thread?})
stored / not_stored - after the turn: [person_id or null, regex] memories that
must be saved / must be gone (the sandbox's in-memory store)
